status: calibrated modern-analogue inputs; not historically validated
replaces: Uniform hypothetical food stocks are absent from default mode; old resource experiment remains in engine source/tests only.

calibrated.density: 111 terrestrial-mobile observations; log density on log rain,T/10,(T/10)^2; fit.json coefficients, spatial-block CV and bootstrap predictive envelope
calibrated.mobility: Joint empirical distribution of original annual miles converted to km and annual household move counts; climate fits rejected by CV
calibrated.land_area: Positive-elevation projected0.5km raster cells each0.25km² allocated to nearest numerical site; references sum predictions times physical area, not a fixed amount per node
calibrated.coverage: No prediction outside convex hull of observed temperature/log-rainfall. Site requires>=80% of its assigned land area supported; unknown sites cannot be selected as destinations. This is a coverage restriction, not evidence of uninhabitability.

structural_assumptions.spatial: 550 irregular sites,60km straight-line candidate radius, whole-segment terrain mask,30km connected-neighbor occupancy comparison
structural_assumptions.destination: Log-distance preference around sampled annual distance/move-count, width0.35; divided by1+(nearby people+own people)/nearby density-reference people. Not fitted against observed paths.
structural_assumptions.schedule: Sample one observed mobility pair/group; even intermove intervals; daily decision resolution; 24km/day travel timing is assumed; monthly display snapshots retain all exact journey records
structural_assumptions.population: 426 synthetic initial people/six groups; no fission in calibrated mode; same modern births/deaths annual; no resource-mediated demography
structural_assumptions.uncertainty: Lower/upper90% approximate predictive bounds used as sensitivity scenarios. Bounds are not posterior trajectories or ancient arrival intervals. No independent archaeological validation.
